# Loop Actions

The command builder offers multiple loop actions. They allow you to start and stop actions from repeating for a set number of times. Below you may find some general information about each block. Click on its name for more information.

<table><thead><tr><th data-type="content-ref">Block</th><th>Information</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><a href="/custom-commands-and-events/actions/loop-actions/run-a-loop.md">Run a Loop</a></td><td>The run a loop action allows you to trigger actions that will repeat for a set number of times.</td></tr><tr><td><a href="/custom-commands-and-events/actions/loop-actions/stop-a-loop.md">Stop a Loop</a></td><td>The stop a loop action allows you to break out of any active loops within the command or event, and trigger blocks that fall under the "After loop" section.</td></tr></tbody></table>
